fun exportIfRequested(context: Context, samples: FloatArray, vocabulary: WhisperVocabulary) {
    if (BuildConfig.BUILD_TYPE != "dataQa" || Build.HARDWARE !in setOf("ranchu", "goldfish")) return
    val directory = context.noBackupFilesDir.canonicalFile
    val request = File(directory, REQUEST)
    if (!request.isFile) return
sourceSpans.interpretation: The function accepts the caller FloatArray and vocabulary, returns Unit, and exits unless explicit DataQa/emulator/request gates hold.

sourceSpans.interpretation: Reads and verifies the pinned source WAV and validates captured FloatArray contents/size. Consumes the one-shot request file. Validation iterates samples; no element assignment occurs.

Allocates a distinct ByteBuffer/byte array and serializes each Float sample as a clamped PCM16 value into that separate buffer. The conversion changes exported representation, not the original FloatArray. Writes use CREATE_NEW.

Vocabulary is read only through name; frames/nonzero/RMS/peak are read from samples. Metadata and local PCM bytes are written. The finally block clears bytes, the separately allocated byte array, not samples.
Ordinary Exception failures are caught and logged by class name. The digest helper returns SHA256 text; it does not modify captured samples.

This rules out those direct mutations in this file, not all differences between the diagnostic and clean builds.
